business_context: Sales and customer usage data was trapped in on-premise relational databases. Early AWS migrations hit severe write bottlenecks due to Parquet file write distribution and S3 metadata rename penalties.
summary_angle: ETL Developer specializing in SQL Server-based extraction, data lake ingestion, and warehouse analytics on AWS

phase_1_ingestion.daily_activity: Extracting historical relational records and sales data from enterprise databases into the cloud ecosystem.
swappable_categories: Extraction Tools (AWS DMS, Stitch, Fivetran, Kafka Connect)

phase_2_storage.daily_activity: Landing extraction files into S3 and executing native transformations on unstructured/flat files.

phase_3_transformation.daily_activity: Authoring PySpark and Glue jobs to clean and aggregate revenue metrics, resolving batch write delays by tuning Parquet block/page sizes and S3 partition keys.
key_optimizations: Tuned Parquet block/page sizes and Snappy compression
Eliminated S3 metadata rename overhead through optimized partitioning
swappable_categories: Serverless ETL (Databricks Serverless, AWS Lambda, Google Cloud Dataflow)

phase_4_orchestration_and_modeling.phase_name: Analytical Querying, Data Quality & Storage Management
phase_4_orchestration_and_modeling.daily_activity: Loading curated sales datasets into analytical stores, writing complex SQL window functions, and enforcing daily data validation checkpoints.

phase_5_serving_and_bi.daily_activity: Designing and deploying interactive Tableau, Power BI, and SSRS dashboards connected directly to Athena and Redshift for revenue KPIs.
